items.title: US FAA says it will phase out floppy disks from air traffic control by 2028
items.summary: The US FAA has announced plans to completely phase out the use of floppy disks in air traffic control systems by the year 2028. This update affects legacy aviation infrastructure. No action is required for software developers.

items.summary: Claude Code's 'Don't Ask Again' feature inadvertently stores sensitive commands containing passwords and API keys into session histories exposed on GitHub. Developers using Claude Code are affected. Check public repositories and revoke any leaked credentials immediately.

items.title: AgensGraph 2.18 Released: Graph Database on PostgreSQL 18 with Expanded ISO GQL Support
items.snippet: The AgensGraph Development Team is pleased to announce the release of AgensGraph v2.18.6.1, the latest version in the 2.18 series. AgensGraph is an open-source graph database, built on PostgreSQL 18.6, that runs SQL and graph queries over the same data, in the same transaction and even in the same statement. AgensGraph 2.18 is a major step toward the ISO GQL standard (ISO/IEC 39075), the internat…
items.summary: AgensGraph 2.18.6.1 is an open-source graph database built on PostgreSQL 18.6 supporting SQL and graph queries. Upgrade AgensGraph to 2.18.6.1 or later.

items.title: Brume: FK-safe pseudonymization for PostgreSQL test and debug copies
items.snippet: Brume 2.1, an open source (Apache 2.0) tool that creates deterministic, foreign-key-safe pseudonymized copies of PostgreSQL databases for testing, debugging and demos, is now available. Why Brume? Development teams often need realistic data to reproduce bugs, run tests or prepare demos, but copying production exposes real personal data. Classic masking scripts also tend to break referential integ…
items.summary: Brume 2.1 is an open-source tool for creating deterministic, foreign-key-safe pseudonymized copies of PostgreSQL databases. Try Brume 2.1 for testing and debugging environments.

items.title: HeapDeck: an on-call monitor for PostgreSQL on iPhone and iPad
items.snippet: HeapDeck is a new native app for engineers on call for PostgreSQL 13 to 19, on the App Store for iPhone and iPad. It opens on one health verdict with ten tiles. The Locks screen draws the tree from pg_blocking_pids() with the root blocker on top and counts the sessions that stopping it would free. Other screens cover pg_stat_activity, transaction ID wraparound and dead tuples, replication lag and…
items.summary: HeapDeck is a native iOS app for monitoring PostgreSQL 13 to 19 databases on-call. Install HeapDeck on an iPhone or iPad to monitor database health and locks.

items.summary: PG Observability Map 1.0.0 is an interactive web-based tool for visualizing PostgreSQL metrics and system views. Try PG Observability Map 1.0.0 to explore database diagnostics.
